items.headline: Kuwait me drone hamla, 2 Italian mare
items.detail: Kuwait ke hawai raksha kendra par drone hamle me do Italian technician mare gaye aur do log ghayal hue; Kuwait aur Italy ne Iran ko zimmedar bataya, Iran ne inkar kiya.
items.exam_angle: Iran-Kuwait tanav, Hormuz sankat — UPSC IR

items.headline: Ibiza ke paas tanker palta, 1 ki maut
items.detail: Spain ke Ibiza ke paas diesel bhara Malta-flag tanker Med Emre palat gaya; 17 crew me se 1 ki maut hui, 6 ghayal; abhi tel risaav nahi mila, Spain ne pradushan-roktham yojana shuru ki.

items.headline: Colombia supermarket bandhak sankat khatm, sab surakshit
items.detail: Cartagena ke supermarket me 16 ghante ke bandhak sankat ke baad suraksha balon ne sabhi bandhakon ko surakshit chhudaya; ek hamlaawar mara gaya aur baaki giraftar hue.

items.headline: Zelensky ki chetavni: Russia bada hamla karega
items.detail: Ukraine ke rashtrapati Zelensky ne kaha Russia aane wale dinon me bada hamla karne ki taiyari kar raha hai; unhone logo se missile chetavni par dhyan dene ko kaha.

items.headline: ECB ke naye pramukh bane De Cos
items.detail: Eurozone deshon ne Spain ke Pablo Hernandez de Cos ko European Central Bank ka agla pramukh chuna; woh February me Christine Lagarde ki jagah lenge aur pehle Spanish ECB pramukh honge.
